text.arabic_uthmani: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا ۗ وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

words.gloss_range: active Form IV giving or causing-to-arrive of the tree’s yield, with an implied feminine subject recovered from 14:24
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, doing, and Form IV giving or causing to come; locally the transitive Form IV giving branch is selected
words.prose: {{ar:تُؤْتِىٓ}} ({{tr:tuʾtī}}) resumes the good-tree image from 14:24 without renaming the tree: the feminine imperfect makes the prior tree the hidden subject. As Form IV, it presents the yield as active delivery, not mere possession. The root pressure of {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) keeps arrival and enacted doing in the background, while the local transitive frame selects giving: the tree causes its consumable yield to arrive. The opening verb then starts a larger yield protocol, moving from object to time to permission, with the rounded opening sounds of the verb and yield tied at the start and the hamza giving the verb a small articulated check.

topics.headline: Form IV delivery of the yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tree does not merely possess fruit; the Form IV verb makes the yield arrive as an active delivery.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as Form IV, transitive, and governing the explicit yield object.

topics.headline: hidden feminine subject carries the prior tree
topics.reader_payoff: The reader must carry the good tree from 14:24 into the new ayah before the fruit-giving clause is complete.
topics.reason: The verb is 3fs with no explicit subject in 14:25, and the bundle links the subject window back to the tree from 14:24.

topics.headline: arrival-root pressure inside giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the giving as caused arrival and enacted delivery, while local Form IV grammar keeps giving as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) range includes coming and doing, but the local Form IV transitive frame selects giving or causing to arrive rather than simple intransitive arrival.

topics.headline: yield protocol of object, time, and permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a mechanism: active giving, consumable output, repeated time, and permission together define recurring licensed yield.
topics.reason: The local syntax supplies the governed object, temporal adverbial, and permission complement under the opening verb.

topics.headline: opening sound binds verb and yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening delivery and yield as a paired cadence before the clause expands into time and authorization.
topics.reason: The sound rows point to local articulation and vowel patterning in the actual adjacent words, without changing the lexical parse.

words.gloss_range: tree-owned consumable yield as the direct object of the giving verb; wrongful-devouring branches are not selected locally
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, food, fruit, produce, and devouring; locally narrowed to produced nourishment or yield
words.prose: {{ar:أُكُلَهَا}} ({{tr:ukulahā}}) is the governed object of the opening verb, and its suffix sends the reader back to the good tree of 14:24. The word therefore names the tree’s own output, not generic fruit, and it appears before the temporal and permission phrases measure and authorize that productivity. Because the noun belongs to the {{ar:أ ك ل}} ({{tr:ʾ-k-l}}) field, the fruit is presented as consumable yield, goodness made usable for others; broader devouring senses are narrowed away by the tree-owned object frame. Accepted vowel variation lets the same yield be heard with fuller u-u movement or a compressed form without changing its referent, and the same yield term resonates with recurring garden provision (13:35).

topics.headline: tree-owned direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the fruit as the tree’s own delivered object, carried across from the previous ayah rather than introduced as generic produce.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object of the opening verb, and the feminine suffix is linked to the prior tree.

topics.headline: fruit named by consumability

topics.reason: The selected noun names fruit or produce through the eating field, and the local object role makes it the delivered content.

topics.headline: eating-root narrowed away from predatory devouring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the consumption field but does not mistake this tree-owned yield for the root’s wrongful-devouring branch.
topics.reason: The {{ar:أ ك ل}} ({{tr:ʾ-k-l}}) family includes devouring uses elsewhere, but the possessed concrete noun in this clause selects produced nourishment.

topics.headline: variant vowel weight keeps same referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted recitational lightening changes the word’s surface weight without changing the tree-owned yield.
topics.reason: The variant rows preserve the same referent and grammatical role while contrasting fuller and compressed sound.

topics.headline: rare yield noun joins recurring garden provision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the parable-tree yield in a wider recurring-provision field, especially the enduring garden yield at 13:35.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete recurrence evidence, and the local noun is the same produced-yield term.

topics.headline: object precedes temporal and permission qualifiers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first receives the concrete productivity of the good tree before the verse measures and authorizes that productivity.
topics.reason: The local word order places the object immediately after the verb and before the temporal and permission phrases.

words.gloss_range: universal temporal quantifier in construct with the following time noun, covering every relevant interval
words.root_gloss_range: allness, totality, entirety, and related nonselected branches such as weariness; locally the quantifier branch is active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: elastic time unit in the every-time phrase

words.prose: {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}) is an accusative temporal adverbial, and in construct with {{ar:حِينٍۭ}} ({{tr:ḥīnin}}) it makes totality belong to time. The payoff is not vague abundance: the phrase distributes the tree’s giving across every relevant interval. That same totality is narrowed away from weariness or depletion; the word gathers the time-domain rather than exhausting the tree. Its position after the fruit lets concrete yield come first, then expands that yield into no-gap recurrence. The doubled lām in the word gives the allness a compact sound, matching the way every interval is gathered into one scope.

topics.headline: accusative temporal totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that totality is scoped over time, not over every possible object or recipient.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the word an accusative time adverbial in construct with the following time noun.

topics.headline: no-gap distribution across intervals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the tree’s productivity as distributed across every relevant interval rather than as occasional abundance.
topics.reason: The construct quantifier takes the following indefinite time noun as its domain, producing distributive totality.

topics.headline: totality distinguished from weariness

topics.reason: The CRITICAL row distinguishes the universal quantifier from similarly rooted weariness language, and the local phrase selects the quantifier.

topics.headline: yield becomes concrete before totality

topics.reason: The word follows the object and modifies the giving event as its time frame; same-surah totalizing pressure is locally narrowed to time.

topics.headline: geminated sound compresses totality

topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the word and has a small but distinct payoff.

words.gloss_range: elastic time unit completing the every-time construct; each interval is treated as a due moment for yield
words.prose: {{ar:حِينٍۭ}} ({{tr:ḥīnin}}) supplies the time-domain for {{ar:كُلَّ}} ({{tr:kulla}}). The phrase does not choose one fixed scale; the word can cover moments, seasons, or longer spans, and under the universal quantifier each interval becomes a due moment for yield. That reverses finite-sojourn uses of the same time word (2:36; 7:24): here every interval becomes fruiting time. Its recitational marking also carries the sound forward into the permission phrase, so time and authorization meet at the boundary.

topics.headline: time noun completes totality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the following noun as the domain that turns totality into a concrete repeated-time phrase.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive as the second term of the construct phrase and stands before the permission phrase.

topics.headline: elastic interval made ripe for yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that every interval, whether brief or extended, is treated as a due moment for output.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows press the elastic time range and due-time image; local construct grammar universalizes that time unit without fixing one scale.

topics.headline: finite sojourn reversed into repeated fruiting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the contrast with finite sojourn uses at 2:36 and 7:24: here time is universalized into recurring yield.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete references and the local phrase contains the same time term under universal totality.

topics.headline: recitation mark links time to permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the boundary from time into permission as a joined recitational movement, not a hard conceptual break.
topics.reason: The local orthographic mīm mark and nunation are tied to the following preposition in the source rows.

words.gloss_range: causal or instrumental preposition binding the yield to permission as enabling condition
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is a bound preposition that makes the permission phrase govern the tree’s productivity as means and cause. The tree gives through permission and because of permission; the preposition therefore prevents the prior yield claim from sounding self-sufficient. Its scope falls on the giving event, with a possible extension to the yielded fruit itself, but in either case authorization controls the production. The same permission formula also recalls the surah’s opening guidance frame (14:1).

topics.headline: permission as means and cause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the tree’s productivity as enabled through permission and because of permission, not as autonomous generation.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the permission noun and is attached to the opening giving event as means or cause.

topics.headline: scope over event or yielded fruit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the permission phrase interrupts any autonomous reading whether it qualifies the act of giving or the yielded product.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly governs the phrase under the verb; a product-scope nuance remains possible but subordinate to the enabling phrase.

topics.headline: bound marker fuses relation to permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees authorization introduced by a bound dependency marker rather than by an independent explanatory clause.
topics.reason: The local preposition is a proclitic governing the following genitive noun.

topics.headline: authorization formula echoes surah opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the tree’s yield shares the authorization formula used for guidance in the surah opening (14:1).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row gives the concrete 14:1 echo and the local phrase begins the same permission construction.

words.gloss_range: permission or authorization as the governed means/cause of fruiting, sourced in the tree’s Lord
words.root_gloss_range: hearing, ear, permission, allowing, and proclamation; locally permission or authorization is selected with hearing/proclamation pressure
words.prose: {{ar:إِذْنِ}} ({{tr:idhni}}) is the governed permission noun, the hinge between the causal preposition and {{ar:رَبِّهَا}} ({{tr:rabbihā}}). It names authorization as a standing condition for every fruiting interval. The construct makes the tree’s Lord the source of permission, while a less likely objective reading stays secondary. The {{ar:أ ذ ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-dh-n}}) field lets hearing and proclamation press into the word: permission is not a bare abstraction but a granted license. Same-surah echoes connect this authorization of fruiting with the authorization of guidance (14:1; 14:11; 14:23). It also retroactively qualifies the stable tree of 14:24: fixed roots and high branches become fruitful only under authorized dependence.

topics.headline: governed permission as enabling noun

topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and heads a construct with the Lord noun.

topics.headline: construct makes the Lord the source of permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader locates the tree’s productivity in its Lord’s authorization, while a possible objective construct reading remains secondary.
topics.reason: The construct relation is best read subjectively with the Lord as source of permission; the objective possibility is noted but subordinated by role evidence.

topics.headline: hearing and proclamation pressure in permission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels authorization as something heard, granted, and declared, while the local noun still means permission.
topics.reason: The {{ar:أ ذ ن}} ({{tr:ʾ-dh-n}}) family includes hearing and proclamation branches; local grammar selects permission but preserves their image-pressure.

topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references and the local phrase matches the authorization formula.

words.gloss_range: tree-specific Lord or sustainer completing the permission construct
words.root_gloss_range: lord, owner, master, sustainer, nurturer, and cultivator; locally the tree’s sustaining Lord as source of permission
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّهَا}} ({{tr:rabbihā}}) completes the permission construct and makes the Lord relation tree-specific. The suffix links this word to the same prior tree carried by the hidden subject of {{ar:تُؤْتِىٓ}} ({{tr:tuʾtī}}) and the fruit suffix in {{ar:أُكُلَهَا}} ({{tr:ukulahā}}). The {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) range includes lordship, ownership, sustaining, and nurturing; in this botanical frame the cultivator-sustainer pressure is strong, so the tree’s fruit is not self-generated but brought to maturity under its Lord’s permission. The changed possessor also echoes the surah’s opening Lord-and-permission formula (14:1).

topics.headline: tree-specific Lord relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lordship is not generic here; the suffix binds the Lord relation to this very tree.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive in construct and carries the feminine suffix linked to the prior tree.

topics.headline: Lord completes the authorization phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees whose permission enables the yield before the ayah pivots away from the tree scene.
topics.reason: The noun completes the construct headed by the permission noun and closes the phrase before the discourse turn.

topics.headline: cultivator-sustainer pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the Lord title as sustaining cultivation that brings the tree to fruit, while the local word remains a Lord noun.
topics.reason: The {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}) field includes ownership and nurturing; the botanical context foregrounds cultivation without replacing the Lord sense.

topics.reason: The boundary rows identify the same feminine referent behind the verb, fruit, and Lord relation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating or resumptive hinge from the tree’s yield to divine parable-making
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa-}}) is the ayah’s hinge. As coordination, it keeps the tree’s giving and God’s parable-striking in one sequence of productive acts; as resumption, it opens a new discourse frame. The result is a controlled pivot from the parable’s interior to the rationale of parables themselves. Because the particle is bound to the following verb, the turn is not abstract: it immediately launches the divine act of setting forth parables.

topics.headline: coordination and resumption both shape the hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle both links to the tree clause and opens a new explanatory frame.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence licenses coordination, while the CRITICAL particle rows preserve the resumptive discourse reading as a frame shift.

topics.headline: pivot from image to parable rationale
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from inside the tree image to explanation of why God deploys parables.
topics.reason: The following clause names divine parable-striking, so the particle is the structural hinge between image and meta-commentary.

topics.headline: prefixed turn bound to the next verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the discourse turn as inseparable from the next act of parable-striking.
topics.reason: The particle is prefixed to the following verbal clause in the source analysis.

topics.headline: connector helps convert image into divine pedagogy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pivot, verb, divine agent, and parable object combine to turn one image into general divine pedagogy.
topics.reason: The synthesis row is supported by the local sequence after the particle: verb, divine subject, and parable object.

words.gloss_range: ongoing Form I parable-striking or setting-forth, with impact pressure inside the fixed parable idiom
words.root_gloss_range: striking, hitting, setting forth, coining, imposing, traveling in licensed constructions, and other branches; locally parable-setting is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يَضْرِبُ}} ({{tr:yaḍribu}}) begins the meta-commentary clause after the hinge. Its imperfect form changes the completed parable-striking of 14:24 into an ongoing divine practice, and its masculine agreement prepares the explicit subject {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}). The broad {{ar:ض ر ب}} ({{tr:ḍ-r-b}}) field includes physical striking and other branches, but the local object {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) selects the Quranic parable idiom: God forcefully sets forth analogies. That idiom is a recurring Quranic formula for divine parable deployment (16:74; 24:35), contrasts with the tree’s organic giving, and also prepares the next contrastive parable in 14:26. The heavy opening consonant and tight sound cluster give the verb a forceful texture without making every broad root branch locally active.

topics.headline: imperfect makes parable-striking ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees one struck parable in 14:24 become an ongoing divine practice in 14:25.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect indicative and begins the second major clause after the hinge.

topics.headline: agency shifts from tree to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the scene change from the hidden feminine tree’s action to the explicit divine agent’s action.
topics.reason: The verb is masculine singular with the following divine name as explicit subject.

topics.headline: striking impact inside parable idiom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears parable-making as forceful setting forth or imprinting, while the local idiom keeps propounding parables as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The {{ar:ض ر ب}} ({{tr:ḍ-r-b}}) range is broad, but the local object {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) selects the parable idiom; physical striking remains image-pressure, not a separate action.

topics.reason: The boundary rows identify the tense and scope handoff from 14:24 and forward bridge to 14:26.

topics.headline: heavy sound supports impact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the forceful texture of the parable verb without treating every broad root branch as locally active.
topics.reason: The row about extreme polysemy is narrowed by the local parable idiom, while the phonetic row preserves a small impact payoff.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name as explicit subject of parable-striking
words.root_gloss_range: proper divine-name field tied to deity, worship, devotion, and debated derivation; locally the unique divine referent as subject
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) names the subject of parable-striking. The clause does not leave examples as anonymous wisdom; the proper divine name stands between the verb and {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}), centering agency before the parables are named. Root and derivational discussions around {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) can add worship, devotion, or bewilderment pressure, but local grammar keeps the word as the unique divine proper name. The result is divine pedagogy: parables are not merely available analogies, they are set forth by God. It also lets the tree’s licensed giving stand inside the surah’s wider divine-giving language (14:34).

topics.headline: proper name fixes the parable-maker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that parable-making is attributed to God by name, not to an unnamed speaker or intermediary.
topics.reason: The proper noun is nominative and functions as the explicit subject of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: proper name over generic deity field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the absolute divine referent, while generic deity or derivational branches do not replace the local proper-name function.
topics.reason: The local word is the proper divine name with dominant God referent; the {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) field is narrowed to proper-name function here.

topics.headline: worship and bewilderment derivation pressure

topics.reason: The local clause joins the divine name directly to the parable object, and same-surah rows note dense divine agency around the parable field.

topics.headline: divine name centered between verb and object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels agency centered before the parables themselves are named.
topics.reason: The local order places the subject between the verb and its direct object.

topics.headline: named God links yield and broader giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the tree’s licensed giving with the surah’s wider divine giving language (14:34).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row supplies the concrete 14:34 comparison and the local clause names God as parable-maker after the tree’s giving.

words.gloss_range: definite plural parables as the object set forth by God, widening one example into a recognized class
words.root_gloss_range: likeness, counterpart, parable, proverb, representation, standing or appearing; locally divine parables as structured analogies
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) is the object God sets forth, with the people named afterward as beneficiaries. Its definite plural form zooms out from the singular parable of 14:24: the tree is now one member of a recognized class of divine analogies. The {{ar:م ث ل}} ({{tr:m-th-l}}) field gives likeness and standing pressure, so a parable is not ornament but a structured comparison made present before people. The plural category also opens the way to the next contrastive singular parable in 14:26, turning one specimen into a method. In that definite plural, the surah’s repeated parable field is gathered rather than left as isolated examples.

topics.reason: The {{ar:م ث ل}} ({{tr:m-th-l}}) field includes standing and resemblance; local noun use selects parables but preserves presented-model pressure.

words.gloss_range: benefactive or directional preposition marking people as recipients of the parables
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}) attaches the parables to their human destination. Benefit and direction converge: the parables are for people and toward people, not produced by people. Its position after {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) separates content from beneficiary, first naming what God sets forth and then who receives it. The same lām-purpose logic echoes the surah’s opening movement of revelation for human guidance (14:1).

topics.headline: benefit and direction converge

topics.reason: The preposition governs the people noun after the parable object and marks beneficiary or addressee direction.

topics.headline: people are governed recipients, not agents

topics.headline: object before beneficiary

topics.reason: The local word order names the direct object before the beneficiary phrase.

topics.headline: benefactive frame echoes surah guidance purpose

words.gloss_range: definite collective people as governed beneficiaries and antecedent of the remembrance response
words.root_gloss_range: human collective, sociability, perception, and disputed relation to forgetting; locally the general human audience is selected
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) names the recipients of the parables as the definite human collective. Governed by {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li-}}), people are beneficiaries, not agents, and they stand between {{ar:ٱلْأَمْثَالَ}} ({{tr:al-amthāla}}) and the hoped remembrance response. The {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) dispute can keep perception and forgetfulness in view: humans are a social, perceiving audience, yet the final verb shows why they need recollection. The phrase also joins the surah’s wider human-address frame, from guidance for people (14:1) to the final message for people (14:52), with the contrast of human ingratitude sharpened later (14:34). The prior singular act of seeing is thereby absorbed into a public human audience for whom parables are struck.

topics.headline: definite collective human audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognizable human public gathered as one beneficiary audience, not a restricted group or jinn-contrast label.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, collective, governed by the benefactive preposition, and contextually points to humans generically.

topics.headline: genitive recipients of parable-making

topics.headline: perception and forgetfulness dispute becomes local

topics.reason: The {{ar:أ ن س}} ({{tr:ʾ-n-s}}) derivational dispute is not allowed to replace the noun, but the following remembrance verb makes the tension meaningful.

topics.headline: human address across the surah

topics.headline: singular witness absorbed into people

words.gloss_range: particle of hope, expectation, or purpose introducing the final remembrance response without making it automatic
words.prose: {{ar:لَعَلَّ}} ({{tr:laʿalla}}) opens the final response frame. It can carry purpose and hope together: God strikes parables for people so that they may remember, yet the wording leaves the human act of remembering grammatically open rather than automatic, so the theological pressure of divine perhaps is narrowed to human response rather than divine uncertainty. The particle binds that openness to the people just named, and it turns the ayah’s landing away from the parables themselves toward their intended inward effect. It also converts the prior summons to see into a third-person hoped remembering.

topics.headline: purpose and hope held together
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees remembrance as the intended result of parables while the human response remains grammatically open.
topics.reason: Attachment and translation support link the particle clause as purpose or hoped result, not a guaranteed outcome.

topics.headline: particle governs the final response frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the open outcome attached to the human recipients rather than floating as an abstract hope.
topics.reason: The particle governs the pronoun subject in the source analysis and introduces the final predicate content.

topics.headline: divine perhaps as human-agency tension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the theological tension of divine perhaps, narrowed locally to openness in the human act of remembering.
topics.reason: The particle cannot be read as simple divine ignorance; the local purpose clause frames openness on the human response side.

topics.headline: closing tail turns parables toward remembrance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah’s landing move past parables themselves toward inward human recollection.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the final beat and is part of the beneficiary-hope-Form V response architecture.

topics.headline: seeing becomes third-person hoped remembering
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the prior summons to look converted into a third-person hoped response by the people.
topics.reason: The boundary row marks the shift from direct seeing to third-person remembering.

words.gloss_range: Form V imperfect plural remembering as hoped, self-engaging response with no stated object
words.root_gloss_range: remembering, mentioning, reminder, recollection, making present, and other nonselected branches such as gendered marking; locally inward recollection is selected
words.prose: {{ar:يَتَذَكَّرُونَ}} ({{tr:yatadhakkarūna}}) is the final landing of the ayah. Under {{ar:لَعَلَّ}} ({{tr:laʿalla}}), it is not a report that people certainly remember; it is the hoped and purposed response to parables. The verb has no stated object, so remembrance remains open: the parable, God, and the people’s own need can all be gathered into the act. The {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) field makes remembering an active making-present, and Form V makes it self-engaging; the parable prompts, but people must turn the reminder inward. As a counter-move to the possible forgetfulness pressure in the human collective, the same response formula appears with divine signs elsewhere (2:221; 6:152; 16:90) and anticipates the surah’s closing reminder for people (14:52). The doubled consonant in the Form V pattern gives the closing word a small sound image of effortful self-remembrance.

topics.headline: final verb scoped as hoped result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees remembrance as the ongoing desired response, not as an independent report that people have already remembered.
topics.reason: The final verb is imperfect plural and is predicate content under the preceding particle.

topics.headline: no stated object leaves remembrance open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what is remembered is left open enough to include the parable, God, and the people’s own need.
topics.reason: The verb instance is intransitive with no stated object, matching the CRITICAL openness claim.

topics.headline: memory becomes active recall
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels remembrance as reactivation and making-present, not silent storage only.
topics.reason: The {{ar:ذ ك ر}} ({{tr:dh-k-r}}) field includes remembering, mention, and reminder; local Form V selects inward recollection with making-present pressure.

topics.headline: remembering answers possible forgetfulness in people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final verb as a counter-move to the possible forgetfulness pressure in the human collective.
topics.reason: The claim depends on the contested people derivation, so it survives as narrowed semantic pressure rather than controlling the noun.

topics.headline: Form V makes recall self-engaging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that parables prompt people, but the morphology makes remembering an inward act they bring themselves to do.
topics.reason: The local form is Form V, imperfect 3mp, with no stated object.

topics.headline: Form V remembrance as desired response formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes this verb as part of a recurring formula for the intended human response to divine signs (2:221; 6:152; 16:90).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete Form V remembrance parallels.

topics.headline: remembrance is the ayah’s landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the whole chain land in human recollection, converting seen parable into internal response.
topics.reason: The final word closes the ayah after tree, yield, permission, God, parables, and people.

topics.headline: anticipates the surah’s final reminder
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final verb anticipate the surah’s closing purpose statement for people (14:52).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL row gives the concrete 14:52 echo.

topics.headline: gemination suits effortful recall
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the doubled consonant as a small sound image of effortful self-remembrance.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is local to the Form V word and adds a distinct sound payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍۭ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject repeatedly brings forth edible yield across time, while permission and lordly nurture make that productivity governed and renewed rather than self-originating.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the emergence of crop and tree growth, making تُؤْتِىٓ an image of productive output.
Supplies tree and field yield as the concrete output denoted by أُكُلَهَا.
Supplies encompassing totality, extending the yield over every stated interval.
Supplies time, duration, and occasion as the recurring axis of productivity.
Supplies permission and authorization as the condition under which the yield appears.
Supplies gradual cultivation, repair, and completion as the sustaining function of the Lord.

changed_reading.before: A flourishing tree bears fruit repeatedly.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents a governed yield-system whose output is continuously renewed through authorization and sustaining cultivation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَيَضْرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The example is actively fashioned and displayed so that perceivers can re-present it inwardly; the recurring yield is therefore also a repeatable cognitive device rather than botanical decoration.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the depicting and manifesting of an example so that it leaves an effect in another.
Supplies the struck and circulating example as the communicative form being presented.
Supplies perceiving by sight, hearing, or inward sensing, casting the people as active recognizers.
Supplies a reminder that makes an absent thing present again, which is the example's intended cognitive work.

changed_reading.before: God tells a comparison so people may remember its lesson.
changed_reading.after: God makes a perceptible pattern whose repeatedly observed yield keeps reactivating what people are liable to lose from awareness.

baseline_models.mechanism: Giving, edible share, and a human audience combine into a distributive model: the tree's worth lies in making nourishment or benefit available, not merely in possessing life.

activation_trace.role: Supplies giving and bringing something to another, turning fruiting into delivery.
Supplies an allotted edible share or provision, giving the yield a recipient-facing function.
Supplies comprehensiveness, making availability recurrent rather than exceptional.
Supplies humanity as the collective field to which the useful example is directed.

changed_reading.before: The tree's fruit demonstrates its own health.
changed_reading.after: The tree models life that proves its quality by continually delivering a share of benefit to people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening uses the same permission-Lord construction for bringing people out of darkness into light. That recurrence revises the focus yield into repeated, authorized emergence into visibility and understanding: its fruit can be illumination delivered to people.

activation_trace.role: Supplies bringing something out of concealment, the opening's concrete transition assigned to the focus fruit's revelatory effect.
Supplies illumination as the destination and lets the recurring yield function as renewed visibility.
Supplies authorization in the opening and binds its transition to the same condition named in the focus.
Supplies sustained cultivation and completion as the lordly support behind the opening's human transition.
Anchors the transferred mechanism in the focus phrase بِإِذْنِ.
Anchors the sustaining side of the transferred mechanism in رَبِّهَا.

structural_cues: 14:1 has بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ, while 14:25 has بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهَا.
The opening transition concerns ٱلنَّاسَ, and the focus parable is explicitly لِلنَّاسِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated permission-Lord construction and the darkness-to-light movement; I infer that the repeated construction carries an enabling, revelatory function into the fruit image. A live alternative is that permission independently governs two acts without transferring their function.

changed_reading.before: Permission regulates when a healthy tree may produce.
changed_reading.after: Each authorized fruiting can be read as a renewed release of people from obscurity into perceivable light.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered movement from reminder, to remembered blessing, to gratitude, to promised increase turns recurrent fruiting into a feedback loop. The branch image of gratitude as a fresh shoot makes the loop botanical: received yield becomes recognition, recognition becomes gratitude, and gratitude opens further growth.

activation_trace.role: Supplies active reminding at the start of the sequence, making prior events newly present.
Supplies blessing and good condition as the remembered yield that calls for a response.
Supplies recognition of blessing and praise of its giver as the human return movement.
Supplies the branch-distant image of a fresh shoot emerging, allowing gratitude to be visualized as renewed growth.
Supplies explicit increase and growth as the next output of gratitude.
Anchors the feedback loop in the focus image of renewed growth and produce.
Anchors remembrance as the focus's stated human effect.

structural_cues: 14:5 commands reminding, 14:6 commands remembering blessing, and 14:7 places gratitude immediately before increase.
14:25 joins recurrent produce to the hope that people will remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered sequence and the fresh-shoot branch of ش ك ر; I infer a regenerative loop in which the promised increase becomes later fruit. A live alternative is a linear reward sequence with no return from increase to renewed remembrance.

changed_reading.before: The fruit periodically reminds observers of a stable truth.
changed_reading.after: Remembered fruit recruits gratitude, and gratitude regenerates the conditions for further fruit, so memory participates in the cycle it recognizes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier parable makes deeds into fire-ash scattered by a violent wind until their producers cannot retain or command anything earned. Against that failed output, edible recurring fruit reads as consequence that remains substantial, available, and effective.

activation_trace.role: Supplies fire-ash as an already-consumed residue, the material opposite of usable yield.
Supplies a violent wind that makes things light and scatters them, explaining the loss of retained effect.
Supplies effective ability and possession, which the ayah negates for the producers of ash-like works.
Supplies acquired benefit or provision as the output that becomes unavailable in the ash model.
Anchors the contrast in a substantial tree-yield that can actually be received.
Anchors durability in output that repeatedly emerges rather than disperses after one event.

structural_cues: 14:18 and 14:24-25 both use parable constructions and evaluate what humanly consequential output remains.
The ash is unavailable to those who earned it; the focus yield is repeatedly brought forth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ash-output that cannot be retained and a later edible output that recurs; I infer that the two parables contrast failed and durable efficacy. A live alternative is that the ash and tree images classify different people without making material retention itself the point.

changed_reading.before: Fruit signals abundance, while ash elsewhere signals failure.
changed_reading.after: The fruit's goodness includes durable efficacy: unlike scattered earnings, its consequence remains receivable and keeps arriving.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah identifies the tree with an intelligible word and gives it a rooted vertical architecture; the next ayah negates that architecture by total uprooting, and the following ayah transfers stability to believing people through stable speech. The focus fruit therefore becomes the word's recurrent capacity to stabilize lives, not merely information produced by a sentence.

activation_trace.role: Supplies an intelligible expression broad enough to be a statement, identifying what the tree models.

structural_cues: 14:24 supplies fixed root and skyward branch; 14:25 supplies recurrent yield; 14:26 supplies uprooting and no stability.
14:27 repeats ث ب ت around ٱلْقَوْلِ and applies the action to believers in both worldly life and the hereafter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a stable word-tree followed by God stabilizing believers through stable speech; I infer that human stabilization is a principal fruit of the tree. A live alternative is that 14:27 comments on divine support independently rather than naming the fruit's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: A sound doctrine stays rooted and keeps producing good teachings.
changed_reading.after: The rooted word is an architecture that repeatedly makes its recipients steady across changing times and even across the two lives.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence commands spending from allotted provision, identifies fruits as provision, places them inside ceaselessly operating cosmic services, and then echoes the focus with giving from all that was asked. The focus fruit becomes a flow meant to pass through recipients rather than terminate in possession.

activation_trace.role: Supplies money or provision leaving possession through expenditure, assigning an onward path to received yield.

Supplies giving and bringing to recipients in a direct lexical echo of the focus's تُؤْتِىٓ.
Supplies encompassing totality in a second direct echo of the focus's كُلَّ.
Anchors the later circulation mechanism in the focus fruit as an allotted edible share.

structural_cues: 14:31 places giving before a day with no sale or intimate exchange.
14:32-34 moves from water and fruits, through continuous cosmic service, to gifts too numerous to enumerate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, spending, fruit, continuous service, and the lexical echo of giving from all; I infer that the good tree models circulation through recipients. A live alternative is that these later gifts only exemplify divine generosity and do not specify what the focus fruit does after receipt.

changed_reading.before: The tree continually supplies people with nourishment.
changed_reading.after: Its fruit is provision in motion: received from a sustained system, it is meant to be released again through human practice before circulation closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, examples are tied to inhabiting the dwellings of earlier wrongdoers and seeing what action did; then every self receives the counterpart of what it earned, and the whole communication culminates in warning and remembrance. Fruit can thus be the consequence a rooted word keeps ripening in history before it is finally returned as recompense.

activation_trace.role: Supplies inhabiting a dwelling, turning earlier outcomes into an environment later people physically occupy.

structural_cues: 14:45 repeats the focus phrase of striking examples after directing attention to inhabited remains and disclosed action.
14:51 moves from each self's earnings to exact recompense, and 14:52 closes with warning, knowledge, and recollection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies material historical exempla, earned output, recompense, and a closing reminder; I infer that fruit can name consequences ripening through time and returning to their producer. A live alternative is that these are separate warning devices and that fruit denotes beneficial effect only.

changed_reading.before: The parable communicates a lesson that remains true in every period.
changed_reading.after: The rooted word repeatedly ripens into inhabitable historical consequences, and those earnings ultimately return to each producer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the fruit through an earlier death scene rather than through adjacent botany. It remains anchored by the exact recurrence of ء ت ي and ك ل ل in a polarity between fruit arriving every time and death arriving from every place. Downstream prose should present it as an intrasure echo or counter-image, not as proof that the two constructions are lexically equivalent or intentionally paired.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the arrival of death, affliction, or destruction as the dark polarity of bringing forth.

Supplies the opposite arrival as emerging growth and produce.

changed_reading.before: The tree is fruitful at every time.
changed_reading.after: Its life-giving arrival fills time as comprehensively as the earlier condemned figure is besieged by death from every place.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relocates fruiting from a planted organism to a protected social and logistical network, and it activates the branch-distant image of benefit arriving from elsewhere. It remains anchored in تُؤْتِىٓ أُكُلَهَا and لِلنَّاسِ, while 14:37 explicitly joins a valley without cultivation, inclined human hearts, provision, and fruits. Downstream prose should qualify it as a network analogy, not identify the focus tree with the sanctuary or claim a literal flood.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the exploratory image of a benefit arriving from a rain-fed land into a land without rain, recasting fruiting as transfer across places.
Supplies an edible share or provision as what the transfer delivers.
Supplies a valley as a channel, giving the no-crop setting a spatial conduit rather than a productive field.
Supplies negation and otherness in غَيْرِ ذِى زَرْعٍ, marking the absence of ordinary cultivation.
Supplies crop growth as precisely the productive capacity negated in the valley.
Supplies human hearts as inwardly heated centers that can become the social carriers of provision.
Supplies inward inclination, providing the motive force that draws people toward the barren place.
Supplies allotted giving as the provisioning function generated through the network.
Supplies fruit as realized benefit, the outcome that reaches a place unable to grow it ordinarily.

changed_reading.before: A rooted tree produces locally from fertile conditions.
changed_reading.after: A rooted good can organize attraction and transfer so effectively that a place without cultivation receives recurring social fruit.

strongest_changes: The repeated بِإِذْنِ رَبِّ construction turns fruit into authorized human emergence from obscurity toward light.
The 14:24-27 sequence makes recurrent fruit the stable word's capacity to stabilize people across times and lives.
The 14:31-34 sequence makes fruit a circulating provision sustained by continuous infrastructure and released through recipients.
The exact ء ت ي plus ك ل ل echo sets temporally pervasive fruit against spatially pervasive death.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence changed the focus from a static botanical compliment into several live mechanisms: revelatory release, regenerative gratitude, durable consequence, human stabilization, provision circulation, and an exploratory social orchard in a no-crop valley.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer of the opening darkness-to-light function through the shared permission-Lord construction is abductive rather than grammatically required.
The gratitude-as-fresh-shoot branch is visibly anchored but branch-distant, so the feedback loop should remain qualified.
The death counter-image and barren-valley network are strong lexical or structural activations, not claims of exclusive intended interpretation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Yield is recurrent provision authorized at each due occasion.** `ء ت ي` `B007` (produced increase), `ء ك ل` `B002` (fruit/yield) and `B003` (provision), `ك ل ل` `B003` (totality), `ح ي ن` `B001` (due occasion), and `ء ذ ن` `B004` (authorization) describe reliable recurrence rather than one harvest. The later cosmic provisions and uncountable favors scale the same mechanism. I infer the tree's continuity is governed responsiveness, not self-sufficient productivity. “Every time” reads as every fitting occasion.

2. **Examples strike memory into renewed presence.** `ض ر ب` `B001` (impact) and `B003` (example), `م ث ل` `B011` (lesson/sign), and `ذ ك ر` `B003` (bring to mind) assign parable a mnemonic role. The packet supplies repetition of “striking examples” again in the ruined dwellings. I infer analogy leaves a retrievable impression; the ayah reads as designed cognitive activation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Human inability to encompass favors in 14:34 expanded “every due occasion” beyond count, while 14:52 confirmed recollection as the intended extraction from repeated examples.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Yield is recurrent, timed, and authorized rather than automatic.** `ء ك ل B002` supplies fruit or yield, `ح ي ن B001` the due occasion of a thing, `ء ذ ن B004` authorization, and `ر ب ب B002` stagewise nurture. The fixed tree gives at every due interval; 14:24 supplied its structure, 14:26 removes the rival tree's base, and 14:27 names active stabilization. The packet supplies structure, recurrence, and authorization; I infer a governed production cycle. `تُؤْتِى أُكُلَهَا` reads as reliable but dependent generativity.
2. **The fruit is mnemonic uptake.** `ذ ك ر B003` supplies bringing something to mind and `ذ ك ر B009` reminder or admonition. The verse moves from recurring yield to examples struck for remembrance; 14:28-30 then show favor converted into covering when that uptake fails. I infer that the parable's usable fruit is renewed recollection that can guide action. The botanical yield and cognitive result remain distinct but functionally analogous.
3. **“Every” marks completeness at each occasion, not an undifferentiated forever.** `ك ل ل B003` supplies totality and completeness, while `ح ي ن B001` segments time into due occasions. The pairing gives complete yield in recurring intervals, contrasted by 14:30's temporary enjoyment moving toward an endpoint. I infer that continuity is built from fully realized cycles. `كُلَّ حِين` therefore reads as structured recurrence rather than timeless blur.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:28-30 showed favor becoming covering and temporary enjoyment moving toward fire. Retrospectively, this made remembrance the parable's usable fruit: failure of uptake is followed by exactly the inversion the example was meant to prevent.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السيل الآتي من بلد آخر نفسه ولا ريع الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: أت لمائك أي سهل له سبيلا وذلك السبيل الأتي (jamhara)؛ الأتي الجدول يؤتيه الرجل إلى أرضه (sihah)؛ كل جدول ماء أتي (tahdhib)؛ أت لهذا الماء أي سهل جريه (maqayis)؛ الأتي ما وقع في النهر من خشب أو ورق مما يحبس الماء (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynakların tümü, yağmurun düştüğü başka bir yerden yağmur almamış bölgeye ulaşan seli veya kendi yatağında dışarıdan geçip gelen seli tanımlar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız dışarıdaki yağış alanından gelen sel kalıbına bağlıdır; genel sel veya genel akış değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız belirtilen sel nitelemesine bağlı tutulur ve sözcükten genel bir yalın anlam türetilmez.

concept_map.definition: Yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden, yağmur almamış bir bölgeye yatağı boyunca ulaşıp geçen seldir.

facets.statement: Selin suyu yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden gelir.
Sel, kendi yağmurunu almamış bir bölgeye ulaşıp oradan geçer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yerel yağıştan doğmayan ve yağmur alan başka bir yerden geçerek gelen sel sınırında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Selin ulaştığı yerde yağmur yağmamış, su başka bir yağış alanından gelmişse kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Selin dışarıdaki yağış alanından gelmesi koşulunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden gelen sel

error_profile.preserves: Akan büyük su kütlesi olma niteliğini korur.
error_profile.adds: Yerel yağmurdan doğan selleri de kapsayarak zorunlu dış kaynak koşulunu kaldırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sel, yağmur alan başka bir bölgeden yağmur almamış bölgeye gelmelidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal her türlü su akışını, akıtmayı, akan suyu ve akış yerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da yatakta ilerleyen akan su bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kaynağı ve hedef bölgenin yağış durumuyla sınırlı özel bir sel türüdür; komşu dal genel akış alanıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel su akışı dalı, bu kalıbın dışarıdan gelme koşulunu en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: السيل الذي يأتي من بلد أصابه المطر إلى بلد لم يصبه المطر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الجدول المصنوع ولا الغريب من الناس
branches.source_phrase_ar: الأتي السيل بعينه يأتيك من بلد مطر من غير بلدك (jamhara)؛ سيل أتي وأتاوي إذا جاءك ولم يصبك مطره (sihah)؛ المسيل الذي يأتي من بلد قد مطر فيه إلى بلد لم يمطر فيه أتي (tahdhib)؛ السيل المار على وجهه أتي وأتاوي (mufradat)؛ الأتي أيضا السيل الذي يأتي من بلد غير بلدك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, içinde bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı erkeği ortak biçimde tanımlar ve dal çerçevesindeki sınırı doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam yalnız bir topluluk içinde onlardan olmayan yabancı kişi nitelemesine bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kişi niteleyen kalıpla sınırlıdır; her gelen kişi veya dışarıdan gelen sel bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluk içinde bulunan, fakat o topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı erkektir.

facets.statement: Kişi bir topluluğun içinde bulunur ancak o topluluktan değildir.
Kişi topluluğa göre yabancı ve dışarıdan gelmiş sayılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmaması ve bu nedenle yabancı sayılması üzerinde birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin içinde bulunduğu topluluğun mensubu olmadığını belirtmek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluk içinde bulunma ve ona mensup olmama sınırını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: içinde bulunduğu topluluğa mensup olmayan yabancı adam

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin gruba göre dışarıdan oluşunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Bir topluluk içinde bulunmayan kişiler ile tanınmayan şeyleri de kapsayabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin topluluğa yabancı oluşunu bildirir, sonradan karışma biçimini zorunlu kılmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal topluluğa dışarıdan girip ona karışan kişi görünümünü özellikle taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir topluluk içinde o topluluktan olmayan kişiyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal mensubiyet dışılığını merkez alır; komşu dal dışarıdan girme ve topluluğa karışma görünümünü daha belirgin taşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; topluluğa karışmış yabancı dalı mensubiyet ile sonradan giriş arasındaki farkı en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: الرجل الغريب في قوم ليس منهم، وما يقال له أَتِيّ أو أتاوي
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل آت مطلقا ولا السيل الآتي من بلد آخر
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل أتي وأتاوي وهو الغريب (jamhara)؛ الاتي أيضا والاتاوى الغريب (sihah)؛ إنما هو أتي فينا (tahdhib)؛ به شبه الغريب فقيل أتاوي (mufradat)؛ رجل أتي أي غريب في قوم ليس منهم وأتاوي كذلك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ekin ve hurmanın ürünü, gelişmesi ve bol verimi ile suyun çoğalmasını destekler. Çalkalanan tulumdan yağın çıkması ise yalnız ayrı kalıbın kaynak ifadesiyle açıklanabilen, çekirdeğe bağlı olmayan bir kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bitkisel ürün ve artış çekirdektir; suyun çoğalması uzantı, tulumdan yağ çıkması ise ayrı kalıp kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ürün ve gelişme bildiren biçim, suyun çoğalması ve çalkalanan tulumda yağın belirmesini bildiren kalıptan ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Ekin ve hurmanın gelişip ürün vermesi, ürününün ve veriminin bol olmasıdır; suyun çoğalması da bu artış alanına uzanır. Ayrı bir kalıp, çalkalanan tulumda yağın ortaya çıkmasını bildirir.

facets.statement: Ekin veya hurma gelişir, ürün verir ve verimi artar.
Suyun miktarı çoğalır.
Ayrı bir kalıpta çalkalanan tulumun yağı ortaya çıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bol verimi merkez alır; su artışı ve tulum yağının belirmesi farklı kapsamlı kullanımlardır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ekin veya hurmanın gelişmesi, ürün çıkarması ve veriminin artması birlikte anlatılacağında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkisel gelişme, ürün ve bolluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ekinin veya hurmanın çıkan ürünü ve yüksek verimi adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bitkinin ürünü ile verim bolluğunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelişme sürecini, suyun çoğalmasını ve tulum yağı kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ekin ve hurmanın gelişmesi, ürünü ve bol verimi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal ürünün yanında gelişme, verim bolluğu ve suyun çoğalması kapsamlarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ağaç, hurma, ekin ve toprağın verdiği ürünü daha genel bir ürün adı olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal ekin ve hurmanın meydana getirdiği ürünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ürünle birlikte gelişme ve bolluk sürecini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ürünün kendisine daha genel biçimde yönelir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ürün dalı, ürünün kendisi ile gelişme ve bol verim arasındaki ayrımı en iyi belirginleştirdi.
branches.what_is_ar: ريع الزرع والنخل وثمرهما، وكثرة الماء، وما يجيء من زبد السقاء عند الصحاح والمفردات
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإيتاء بمعنى الإعطاء ولا الإتاوة المفروضة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أتاء هذا النخل أي ثمره وكذلك الزرع (jamhara)؛ الاتاء البركة والنماء وحمل النخل (sihah)؛ جاء أتوه (sihah;mufradat)؛ إتاء النخلة ريعها وزكاؤها وكثرة ثمارها (tahdhib)؛ الإتاء نماء الزرع والنخل وأتى الماء إتاء أي كثر (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yönetime ödenen vergi veya baş vergisini ortak alan olarak verir ve aynı toplu iddia içinde bir kişiye sunulan rüşvet kullanımını da bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Düzenli veya zorunlu kamu ödemesi çekirdektir; rüşvet, aynı biçimin ayrı kalıptaki özel kullanımıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Vergi adı olarak kullanılan biçim ile birine rüşvet vermeyi bildiren kalıp kapsam bakımından ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun veya kişinin yönetime ödediği vergi ya da baş vergisidir. Ayrı bir kalıpta, bir kimseye çıkar sağlamak için verilen rüşveti veya rüşvet verme eylemini anlatır.

facets.statement: Topluluk veya kişi yönetime vergi niteliğinde para öder.
Ödeme baş vergisi veya benzeri yükümlülük niteliği taşır.
Ayrı bir kullanımda bir kimseye rüşvet verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia vergi ve baş vergisi anlamlarını ortaklaştırır; rüşvet kullanımı kaynaklara ayrı ayrı dağıtılamayan özel bir karşılık olarak aynı iddiada yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yönetime ödenen mali yükümlülük ile ayrı rüşvet kullanımı birlikte gösterileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Vergi, baş vergisi ve ayrı rüşvet kullanımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun veya kişinin yönetime yaptığı zorunlu mali ödeme söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönetime yapılan mali yükümlülük ödemesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Rüşvet olarak verilen ödeme kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal aynı biçimin rüşvet kullanımını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişiye, köleye veya toprağa konan vergi, gelir ve görev ödemelerini daha geniş sınıflar halinde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir kişi veya topluluğa yüklenen vergi ve kamu ödemesi alanında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal vergi adının yanında rüşvet kullanımına sahiptir; komşu dal ise üzerine konan mali yükümlülük türlerini daha geniş kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; mali yükümlülük komşusu vergi çekirdeği ile rüşvet uzantısı arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: الخراج أو الجزية أو الرشوة التي يؤديها القوم أو الشخص
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإيتاء بمعنى مطلق الإعطاء ولا ريع الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: الإتاوة الخراج أو الجزية يؤديه القوم إلى الملك (jamhara)؛ الاتاوة الخراج والجمع الاتاوي (sihah)؛ الإتاوة الخراج وجمعها الأتاوى والإتاوات (tahdhib)؛ أتوته أتوة إذا رشوته إتاوة وهي الرشوة (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bütünüyle devenin yürüyüş sırasında ön ayaklarını geri getirme hareketini anlatır ve verilen dal sınırıyla örtüşür.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız devenin yürüyüşte ön ayaklarını geri getirme biçimini niteleyen kalıba bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım devenin ön ayak hareketini bildiren kalıpla sınırlıdır; genel yürüyüş veya geliş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Devenin yürürken ön ayaklarını ileri adımdan sonra düzenli biçimde geri getirme hareketidir.

facets.statement: Deve yürüyüş sırasında ön ayaklarını geri getirir.
Bu hareket devenin yürüyüş niteliği olarak değerlendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, devenin yürüyüşünde ön ayakların geri getirilişini aynı hareket niteliği olarak tanımlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin yürüyüşündeki belirli ön ayak hareketi adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanı, yürüyüş bağlamını ve ön ayakların geri hareketini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: devenin yürürken ön ayaklarını geri getirişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal özellikle devenin ön ayaklarını geri getirmesine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal farklı bineklerin ayak hareketini, adımını ve bir yürüyüş türünden ötekine geçişini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal yürüyen bir hayvanın ayaklarını geri getirme hareketini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal deve ve ön ayaklarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal hayvan ve yürüyüş türü bakımından daha geniştir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel binek ayağı hareketi komşusu, deveye ve ön ayaklara özgü sınırı en açık biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: أتو أو أتي يدي الناقة، أي رجع يديها في السير
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مطلق الإتيان ولا طريق الماء
branches.source_phrase_ar: ما أحسن أتو قوائم الناقة وأتيها في السير (jamhara)؛ ما أحسن أتو يدي هذه الناقة وأتي أيضا أي رجع يديها في السير (sihah)؛ ما أحسن أتو يديها وأتي يديها يعني رجع يديها (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yarışın son sınırı, işlek ya da yürünmüş yol, yol kavşağı ve bir evin karşısında veya hizasında olma kullanımlarını açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yol adı, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama aynı biçim ailesindeki ayrı kullanımlardır; biri ötekine indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yol ve son sınır bildiren adlar ile bir evin karşısında bulunmayı bildiren kalıp ayrı kapsamlar olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: İşlek veya yürünmüş ana yol, yolların birleştiği yer ya da yarış atlarının koşusunun bittiği son sınırdır. Bir konum kalıbında, bir evin karşısında veya onunla aynı hizada bulunmayı bildirir.

facets.statement: İnsanların kullandığı işlek veya yürünmüş ana yol adlandırılır.
Yolların birleştiği kavşak veya yolun belirgin ana kesimi anlatılır.
Yarış atlarının koşusunun ulaştığı son sınır adlandırılır.
Bir yapı başka bir yapının karşısında veya aynı hizasında bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt yol, kavşak ve yarış sonu anlamlarını; ayrıca yapıların karşı karşıya veya aynı hizada oluşunu bildiren kalıbı bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.text: işlek ana yol, son sınır ve karşı hizası
concept_gloss.applicability: Yol ailesindeki temel adlar ile yarış sonu ve karşıda bulunma kullanımları topluca temsil edileceğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yol, kavşak, yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama kapsamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsanların yürüdüğü veya yolların birleştiği belirgin yol adlandırıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlek ve yürünmüş yol anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Yarış sonu ile bir yapının karşısında veya hizasında bulunma kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: yarışın son sınırı; işlek ana yol veya yol kavşağı
yarışın son sınırı veya yolun ana kesimi
bir evin karşısında veya aynı hizasında

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yarışın son sınırını ve bir yapının karşısındaki hizayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yolun toplandığı ana cadde ve bu caddeyi tutma eylemiyle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal işlek ana yol ve yolların birleştiği yer anlamında kesişir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yol çekirdeğinin ötesinde yarış sonu ve konumsal hizalama kullanımlarına sahiptir; komşu dal bu uzantıları taşımaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ana yol ve kavşak komşusu, dalın yol dışındaki yarış sonu ve hizalama kapsamlarını en iyi açığa çıkardı.
branches.what_is_ar: الميتاء والميداء: آخر الغاية، والطريق العامر أو المسلوك، ومجتمع الطريق، ومحاذاة الدار
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجيء الشخص ولا الجدول المائي
branches.source_phrase_ar: الميتاء والميداء آخر الغاية حيث ينتهي إليه جري الخيل (sihah)؛ الميتاء الطريق العامر ومجتمع الطريق (sihah)؛ داري بميتاء دار فلان وميداء دار فلان أي تلقاء داره ومحاذية لها (sihah)؛ طريق ميتاء مسلوك وميتاء الطريق وميداؤه محجته (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kalıplarda kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesini; malın yok olmasını; kişinin öldürülüp götürülmesini ve düşmanın yaklaşmasını destekler. Genel olarak gelişin iyi veya kötü olabileceği notu, bu dalın yalnız zararlı kalıplarını genişletmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirtilen zarar ve tehdit kalıplarına bağlıdır; genel gelme eylemi veya her türlü yok oluş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ölüm, hastalık, mal kaybı, yenilgi ve düşman yaklaşması anlamları yalnız kendi kalıplarında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kalıplarda bir kişiye ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya kırık gelmesi; malının yok olması; öldürülüp götürülmesi ya da düşmanın ona yaklaşmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi ölüm, ağır hastalık, bela veya uzuv kırılması gibi ağır bir zarara uğrar.
Bir kişinin malı yok olur.
Bir kişi öldürülür, götürülür veya üzerinde üstünlük kurulur.
Düşman kişiye yaklaşır ve tehdit oluşturur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, farklı kalıplarda kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve yaklaşan düşman tehdidini sıralar; genel gelişin olumlu da olabileceği ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.text: felakete uğramak, kaybetmek veya düşmanca ele geçirilmek
concept_gloss.applicability: Kanıttaki farklı zarar kalıplarının ortak olumsuz sonucunu topluca göstermek için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel felaket, mal kaybı, öldürülme veya götürülme ve düşman tehdidi kapsamlarını korur.
